verdict: PASS: ESD predicts |eta_Pt-Ti| ~ 2.6e-23, 8 orders below the MICROSCOPE 2022 bound and 6 orders below the projected MICROSCOPE-2 sensitivity. The screening factor beta_m^2 ~ 1e-09 that delivers GR-PPN recovery in the solar system also delivers automatic EP safety. ESD is unobservable by any currently planned WEP experiment; only an improvement of >6 orders in eta-sensitivity would test it.
